correctness.rationale: For all a_i,a_j,D_i,D_j,r>0 and 0<=q<1, contracting synchronous jump diffusion has a unique all-moments stationary law. The exact generator yields mean energies 2D_h/L_h and mixed covariance 4D_iD_j*delta*u/(L_iL_j*(L_i+L_j-delta*u)). Its squared-energy eigenfunctions yield directional lag exponentials, the ratio, and unique peak. Algebraically the observed energy covariance and a single lag determine delta, u, r, q uniquely; forward and reverse formulas and backward common-clock Monte Carlo were checked using the packaged standalone checker.
